title: Weekly numbers view for the investor update
text:
After launch, Maya has to send fresh numbers to Lena at Harbor Seed Fund and currently pulls them by hand from SQL.

Create a simple internal view/query with: sign-ups, weekly active students, groups formed, groups that met at least twice, and week-over-week change. Beta baseline was 214 sign-ups, 131 weekly active (61%), 58 groups.

Daniel to expose the query, Wop to check the format with Maya.
